notes: Exalted: The Abyssals reviewed cover-to-cover for player-facing mechanics (Chapters One through Six). 287 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/abyssal/inventory/: the character-creation overview, the universal Anima Effect, all five Castes, the Abyssal Curse, the Virtues of Death, the full Resonance mechanic (gain/loss/manipulation), the-title, Useful Crafts, the Cult exclusion sidebar, the six new deathknight-only Backgrounds, the altered Backgrounds, all 228 Chapter Five Charm rows covering every Ability line for all five Castes (Dusk, Midnight, Daybreak, Day, Moonshadow), Chapter Six's complete 26-spell necromancy system across all three circles (Shadowlands 9, Labyrinth 9, Void 8), 4 of 5 Crafts of the Dead (Necrosurgery confirmed to have no dedicated framework block), and a confirmed absence of Abyssal-specific Merits/Flaws. The corpus-rending-blow prerequisite gap (a mistranscription duplicate of the same Occult Charm) was resolved, unblocking ghost-warding-glyph. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. A handful of Chapter Five rows still need a dedicated tree-topology disambiguation pass and two rows (soaring-raptor-prana, striking-snake-grab) need a follow-up close read before promotion (see source-manifest.json rulesNotes). Chapter Six's ghost/NPC Arcanoi trees and Chapter Seven's Storytelling material are GM-facing and intentionally out of scope. Locked pending schema/rules/creator/editor implementation and passing tests across all five planned families.
